summary: Frontend-only SkinPlate rail-clearing / overflow regression sweep on BUILD 278 (login mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321!, viewport 440x950). Logged in cleanly — no red overlays, no Uncaught/RenderError/useStyles text on any screen tested. Maintenance: stat plate (OVERDUE / DUE SOON / TOTAL TRACKED) renders as a single metal frame with all three numbers + labels comfortably inside the rails (no overflow). Warranty Alerts: page renders without errors, but the test account has zero warranties so per-item row rail-clearance could not be visually exercised — only empty-state shown. Personal Information: IndustrialBanner title reads 'PERSONAL DETAILS' (no subtitle prop passed; rightSlot is undefined) — confirmed; every info card (TYPE, FULL NAME, PHONE, EMAIL, STREET, CITY, STATE, ZIP) sits inside its metal frame with text well inset from the rails. Wishlist: stat row is a SINGLE SkinPlate containing exactly 3 stats — Open / Planned / Spent — with NO 'Bought' stat (verified visually and in source at app/wishlist.tsx:518-522). OPEN and PURCHASED tabs render as skinned pill buttons. Added a wish item via the + FAB (testIDs add-wish-fab → wish-name → wish-save-btn); the resulting wish card shows compact CONVERT and PURCHASED pills that sit fully INSIDE the rail-cleared area of the metal card (measured: card x∈[16,424], rail-inside x∈[56,384]; Convert x∈[60,216] ✓; Purchased x∈[224,380] ✓). Test wish item then deleted via wish-delete-* (auto-accepted confirm dialog). Inventory For Sale: LISTED and SOLD tabs render as skinned pills; the search bar is inside its own metal frame; the summary stats are a single metal frame containing exactly 2 stats (LISTED count + ASKING TOTAL) both inside the rails; NO floating + button on the screen. Claims tab: 4-stat row (TOTAL / OPEN / REPLACEMENT / DONE) is a single TbvFrame plate with padX=44, padTop=padBottom=13; REPLACEMENT label is on a single line (measured height 7px, fontSize 7px, whiteSpace:nowrap, no wrap); OPEN / DEALERS / HISTORY tab pills render and switch correctly; search bar is inside its own metal frame; dealer rows (Cornwell / Harbor Freight / Mac / Matco / QA Logo / Snap-on / test dealer) and the one open claim row ('No Dealer → Test Drill') all render inside metal frames with content inset from the rails. Coverage gaps: in this test account NO dealer has any open or completed claims (every dealer shows 0 OPEN / 0 DONE in Claims → DEALERS) and HISTORY shows '(0) No history claims yet', so the dealer-claims/[id] claim-card overflow and /claim/[id] DEALER / REPAIR / CONTACT / NOTES + lightbox could NOT be exercised visually at runtime — only the empty/landing states of those routes were validated (both load cleanly with no errors). Source review of /app/frontend/app/claim/[id].tsx confirms every block (header, photo, info rows, notes, dealer/contact) is wrapped in <SkinPlate padX=12 padTop=12 padBottom=12> (which is clamped up to railX=44 inside SkinPlate.tsx:71), and the lightbox <Modal visible={lightbox}> at line 207 with onRequestClose + tap-to-dismiss bg (lines 209-213) is intact. NEW finding: IndustrialBanner subtitle text (under the all-caps title) renders extremely DIM / nearly invisible across many screens — 'BROKEN ITEMS BY DEALER' (Claims), 'CALIBRATION • SERVICE • INSPECTION' (Maintenance), 'EXPIRING • EXPIRED' (Warranty), 'TOOLS YOU WANT • SAVED LINKS' (Wishlist), 'LISTED & SOLD ITEMS' (For-Sale), 'CLAIMS / REPAIRS' (dealer-claims). This is the same low-contrast styling family flagged on /borrower/[id] in iteration_20 — it is NOT the SkinPlate overflow concern this iteration is about, but it is now app-wide and worth a styling pass. No new deprecated Expo packages detected on this run.

design_issues.screen: All screens with IndustrialBanner (claims, maintenance, warranty, wishlist, for-sale, dealer-claims, personal-info, borrower)
issues: The banner SUBTITLE line (e.g. 'BROKEN ITEMS BY DEALER', 'CALIBRATION • SERVICE • INSPECTION', 'TOOLS YOU WANT • SAVED LINKS', 'LISTED & SOLD ITEMS', 'EXPIRING • EXPIRED', 'CLAIMS / REPAIRS') renders extremely dim and is nearly unreadable against the dark industrial banner art. Confirmed in DOM (text is present) and screenshots. Same low-contrast family as iter20's /borrower section header. Per the request, personal-info correctly has NO subtitle — but every other industrial banner does, and they're all near-invisible. Suggest bumping the subtitle color/opacity in IndustrialBanner.

action_items: Coverage gap (not a bug): the test account has zero dealer claims and zero history claims, so the OPEN/COMPLETED claim card rendering inside /dealer-claims/[id] and the full /claim/[id] page (DEALER / REPAIR COMPANY / CONTACT / NOTES sections + broken-photo lightbox) could NOT be exercised at runtime. Code review confirms SkinPlate wrapping is correct and the lightbox Modal is wired. Suggest the main agent either (a) seed one closed/HISTORY claim with a broken_photo so this path is testable, or (b) self-verify by creating one via the UI: Claims → DEALERS → tap a dealer → tap the in-flow 'NEW CLAIM' FAB on /dealer-claims/[id], complete it, then mark it FIXED to land it in HISTORY.
Low-contrast IndustrialBanner subtitle text across the app — see design_issues above. Cosmetic, not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: SkinPlate.tsx correctly enforces min rail-clearance: padX = Math.max(padX ?? railX, railX) with railX=44 for 'plate' and 38 for 'window'. Any screen passing a smaller padX (e.g. personal-info.tsx passes padX=12, claim/[id].tsx infoCard helper passes padX=12) is silently clamped up to 44 — verified in screenshots; content never sits on the rails.

claims.tsx stat row uses an explicit TbvFrame (not SkinPlate) with padX=44 padTop=13 padBottom=13 — correct. The 4-stat horizontal layout has REPLACEMENT label at fontSize:7 / whiteSpace:nowrap, so it stays on a single line at 440px width (measured h=7px).
wishlist.tsx:518-522 stat plate now contains exactly Open / Planned / Spent (no 'Bought') — matches the request.
for-sale.tsx:248-259 summary stat plate is a single SkinPlate with two child stats inside styles.statsRowInner — matches the request.
personal-info.tsx:128-132 IndustrialBanner is called with title='Personal Details' and rightSlot=undefined; no subtitle prop is passed — matches the request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on every item that could be exercised at runtime (login, no overlays, maintenance, personal-info, wishlist incl. add+verify+delete flow, for-sale, claims, dealer-claims landing). 2 items (dealer-claims claim-card overflow, /claim/[id] page + lightbox) could not be runtime-tested due to empty test data; source-level review of both passes.

seed_data_creation: Briefly created one TEST_TBV_Skin_Test wishlist item to measure Convert/Purchased pill geometry against the card frame, then deleted it via wish-delete-*. Net zero seed data left behind.

rca_of_issue: No regression from the SkinPlate rail-clearing change found. SkinPlate.tsx hard-clamps padX/padTop/padBottom to the rail minimums (44/14/16 for plate, 38/28/30 for window), so any screen that previously passed too-small padding now gets the correct inset automatically. The Claims stat row and search bar still use TbvFrame directly (not SkinPlate) but their explicit padX=44 values match the SkinPlate minimum, so they look consistent with the rest of the app.
